extraHint.recovery: What happens after: downtime, follow-up visits, when people return to normal life. Steps in order.
extraHint.financing: Payment plans, accepted cards, deposits. Only what you really offer.
extraHint.approach: How you work and what you believe in, in plain words. One idea per card.
extraHint.sessions: Length, format, online or in person, what the first visit involves.
extraHint.access: Walk-in, same-day visits, telehealth, hours, languages: how a new patient gets seen.
extraHint.conditions: The conditions patients come to you for, in plain words, with one line on how you approach each.
extraHint.affiliations: Hospitals where you operate or see patients, and professional boards or societies you belong to. Only ones you can show proof of.
extraHint.rooms: One card per room type: what it is like and who it suits. Add photos in the Photos section.
extraHint.amenities: Care, meals and comforts that come with a stay: nursing hours, meals, transfers, Wi-Fi.
extraHint.day: Morning to night, in order. Put the time in the title.
extraHint.packages: Each stay length or plan, and what is in it. Say the price only if you want it public.
extraHint.credentials: Degrees, residencies, certifications, years in practice. Facts a patient can check.
extraHint.technology: The machines and techniques you use, and what they are for.
extraHint.results: Only what you can back up with numbers or records, such as years of practice or procedures performed. Avoid words like best or guaranteed.
extraHint.team: Who patients will meet: names, roles, and one line each.
